topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: Just got a call from some fancy lawyer on the other side of town. His client, fresh into some old Victorian heap, thinks they hit the jackpot with a hidden room. Figures. Always someone thinking they're the first to dig up yesterday's secrets. Told him if there's anything good down there, it's been gone a long time. Or worse, it's still lurking. Gave him my number, told him to call if he needs someone to sift through the dust. Like I got the time for this. But it’s a job, and jobs are thin these days. Maybe this one’s different. Maybe.
